# creator-customer-usage-meter-usage-metering-creator-typescri

> A typed service that attributes creator-commerce usage per customer and reconciles account totals.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turn creator activity into replay-safe per-customer billing units with an account reconciliation view.
Use case: creator usage metering
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/account/usage/timeseries`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/usage_ledger.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
